entities.name: Boc deprotection of piperazine
observations: Reactant contains a piperazine N-Boc carbamate; product is the corresponding secondary piperazine with that nitrogen converted to NH.
The key transformation is cleavage of the piperazine N–carbonyl bond, with loss of the Boc group; no new ring is formed.
This is an acid-promoted deprotection and the product may be isolated as an amine hydrochloride salt.

entities.name: HCl in dioxane/DCM
observations: Likely reagent system is hydrogen chloride in 1,4-dioxane with methylene chloride as co-solvent.
Reported reaction time was 2.0 hours; temperature was not specified.

entities.name: Hydrogen chloride
observations: Acid reagent used for cleavage of the N-Boc carbamate in the matched reaction.

entities.name: 1,4-Dioxane
observations: Solvent for the reported hydrogen chloride deprotection system.

entities.name: Dichloromethane
observations: Methylene chloride was reported as a solvent or co-solvent for the deprotection.
